reasoning: The glyph shows a T-shaped body with a vertical stem and a semicircular cap on the left end of the horizontal bar. While designed in some icon sets as a single in-ear wireless earbud, its blocky geometry causes most viewers to read it first as a hammer or rubber mallet, or secondarily as a compact hair dryer or massage gun. It fits tasks centered on hammers/mallets and basic carpentry as well as wireless earbuds, though its visual ambiguity lowers its glanceability.

qa.fix: A T-shape with a half-round end on the head and a handle going down: most read it as a hammer/mallet (or hair dryer); an earbud is a stretch.
